alfred.description: Use your Claude.ai Pro/Max subscription as an Alfred LLM provider — no API key, no per-token billing. Drives Claude Code headlessly via the official Agent SDK; inference counts against your subscription quota.

oauthToken.label: Setup token (optional)
oauthToken.description: Long-lived subscription token from `claude setup-token`. Leave empty to reuse the credentials from an interactive `claude` login (~/.claude/.credentials.json). Either way, billing goes against your Claude.ai subscription, NOT the API.

models.label: Models
models.description: Comma-separated list of models to expose in the picker. Use aliases (opus, sonnet, haiku) to always track the latest, or pin full ids (e.g. claude-opus-4-8). Optional display name after a pipe: 'opus|Claude Opus'.

contextWindow.label: Context window
contextWindow.description: Context window (tokens) reported for every exposed model. Used by the UI for the context gauge.

pathToClaude.label: Path to claude executable (optional)
pathToClaude.description: Absolute path to the `claude` CLI binary. Leave empty to use the one bundled with the Agent SDK, or the one on your PATH.
